method: Each binary (name, version, architecture) is looked up in the signed trixie Packages index to find its Source name and version; that source is looked up in the signed trixie Sources index for its pool directory and the sha256 of each source file. Developer-layer results are cross-checked against source-provenance.json. The four binaries that the pinned trixie Packages index does not hold (gap_note) are found by name in the Binary and Package-List fields of the signed trixie-security Sources index (snapshot.debian.org archive debian-security 20260930T060347Z), which also gives the pool directory and the sha256 of each source file of their sources openssl 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 and linux 6.12.111-1.
